rawCommits.subject: feat(public-chat): enable guest SSE streaming with router service key
rawCommits.body:
Remove the interim auth gate that redirected unauthenticated users to
/login, and wire up the full public chat flow:

- Read AURA_PUBLIC_GUEST_KEY service key and pass it as the bearer
  token in SessionConfig so the harness authenticates with aura-router
  as "public-guest" without sharing AUTH_COOKIE_SECRET
- Pass aura_org_id, aura_session_id, and token in SessionConfig to
  satisfy the harness identity preflight
- Hold the SessionBridgeStarted handle alive for the SSE response
  lifetime so the harness WS connection stays open until the agent
  loop completes
rawCommits.cleanSubject: enable guest SSE streaming with router service key

rawCommits.subject: feat(shell): add SimpleShell for web users with simple/advanced toggle
rawCommits.body:
Simplified layout for authenticated web users: sidebar with
conversation list + main chat panel. Composes the existing Chat app
infrastructure (ChatAppLeftPanel, ChatAppRoute) in a clean layout.

- app-mode-store: persisted simple/advanced preference in localStorage
- SimpleShell: titlebar (logo, avatar, Advanced/Logout), sidebar
  (CHATS header, New chat, session list, marketing footer), chat panel
- ResponsiveShell: web + simple → SimpleShell, desktop → DesktopShell
- Suppress WelcomeModal/OnboardingChecklist in simple mode
- Hydrate agent store and profile store on shell mount
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add SimpleShell for web users with simple/advanced toggle

rawCommits.subject: fix(public-chat): add bottom padding to chat scroller for input bar clearance
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add bottom padding to chat scroller for input bar clearance

rawCommits.subject: refactor(public): replace service key with unauthenticated router path
rawCommits.body:
Remove AURA_PUBLIC_GUEST_KEY service key approach. Public sessions
now set SessionConfig.token = None, the harness sends no Authorization
header, and the router assigns public-guest identity with IP rate
limiting. No keys or env vars needed for public mode.

Also removes token requirement from harness identity preflight so
public sessions are not rejected before reaching the router.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: replace service key with unauthenticated router path

rawCommits.subject: feat(public): add global daily ceiling for public mode cost protection
rawCommits.body:
Atomic counter on the rate limiter caps total public turns per day
across all guests and IPs (hardcoded at 500). Checked before per-
guest and per-IP limits so no request can slip through. When hit,
all public requests are rejected until the 24h window resets.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add global daily ceiling for public mode cost protection

rawCommits.subject: feat(shell): desktop parity — remove hasDesktopBridge gates
rawCommits.body:
Desktop users now see LoggedOutShell when not logged in and
SimpleShell when in simple mode, same as web. Removes platform-
specific gates so desktop, web, and future mobile all share the
same public mode and shell experience.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: desktop parity — remove hasDesktopBridge gates

rawCommits.subject: feat(shell): add Simple mode toggle to DesktopShell titlebar
rawCommits.body:
Adds a ghost button in the titlebar actions that switches to
SimpleShell. Both directions now work — Simple has Advanced,
Advanced has Simple. Preference persists to localStorage.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add Simple mode toggle to DesktopShell titlebar

rawCommits.subject: feat(public): add 3D image attachment for logged-out shell
rawCommits.body:
Add source image upload for 3D mode on the public chat surface.
Users attach an image via a file picker, optionally type a prompt,
and send to generate a 3D model via Tripo. Auto-fills the input
with "Generate 3D model" when no text is entered so the send button
enables without modifying the shared InputBarShell.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add 3D image attachment for logged-out shell

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): render assistant image contentBlocks with desktop-style sizing
rawCommits.body:
Add a dedicated render path in MessageBubble for assistant-side image
contentBlocks (used by public mode generated images). Renders at 520px
max with rounded corners, border frame, and click-to-gallery with
download — matching the desktop ImageBlock styling. User attachment
thumbnails (96px) are unchanged.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: render assistant image contentBlocks with desktop-style sizing

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): inline video/3D rendering for public mode + fix glbUrl extraction
rawCommits.body:
Video and 3D messages in public mode now render inline (video player,
WebGLViewer) instead of falling back to markdown links. Fixes 3D
generation not appearing in UI — the Tripo API returns glbUrl which
was missing from both the backend alias normalizer and the frontend
SSE extractor.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: inline video/3D rendering for public mode + fix glbUrl extraction

rawCommits.subject: feat(public): add loading indicators and error states to logged-out shell
rawCommits.body:
Adds ChatStreamingIndicator (cooking shimmer, progress text, stuck
stream pill) and error event synthesis so public mode users see the
same feedback as desktop/simple shell. Errors now render as inline
"stream interrupted" banners instead of failing silently.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add loading indicators and error states to logged-out shell

rawCommits.subject: feat(shell): mobile responsiveness for logged-out and simple shells
rawCommits.body:
Single-column layout below 640px with sidebar as a slide-in drawer
(hamburger toggle in titlebar, backdrop to dismiss). Fixes empty
assistant bubble on media-only messages, converts footer links to
React Router, and improves mode pill overflow on narrow screens.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: mobile responsiveness for logged-out and simple shells

rawCommits.subject: fix(shell): revert footer links to external URLs for desktop parity
rawCommits.body:
React Router Link doesn't work in the desktop app shell for
marketing pages. Restores external <a target=_blank> links so
they open in the system browser on both web and desktop.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: revert footer links to external URLs for desktop parity

rawCommits.subject: fix(public): handle invalid token and server-side limit rejection
rawCommits.body:
Auto-invalidate cached guest token when server returns invalid guest
token error so users are not permanently stuck. Detect limit_reached
error responses and trigger KeepChattingModal instead of showing a
generic error banner.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: handle invalid token and server-side limit rejection

rawCommits.subject: fix(public): check global ceiling after guest/IP limits pass
rawCommits.body:
Reorder try_reserve so the global counter only increments after
per-guest and per-IP checks succeed. Previously rejected requests
(guest already at cap) silently consumed global budget on every
retry attempt.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: check global ceiling after guest/IP limits pass

rawCommits.subject: fix(harness): restore token validation for non-public sessions
rawCommits.body:
Only skip the auth token check when aura_org_id is public. Previously
the check was removed entirely, weakening the safety net for
authenticated sessions. Fixes the failing validate_rejects_missing_auth_token test.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: restore token validation for non-public sessions

rawCommits.subject: fix(public): correct stale closures and remove dead code
rawCommits.body:
Fix handleFileChange dep array (missing controller.input). Add limit
and invalidateToken to dispatchChatTurn and dispatchMedia deps. Remove
unused requiresLogin property and useAuth import.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: correct stale closures and remove dead code

rawCommits.subject: fix: remove unused DisplayContentBlockUnion import
rawCommits.cleanSubject: remove unused DisplayContentBlockUnion import

rawCommits.subject: fix(shell): auto-switch to advanced mode for non-chat deep links
rawCommits.body:
SimpleShell was redirecting all non-chat URLs to /chat, breaking
bookmarks, project deep links, and CI e2e tests. Now auto-switches
to advanced mode instead so the full DesktopShell renders for
routes that require it.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: auto-switch to advanced mode for non-chat deep links

rawCommits.subject: fix(shell): redirect to /chat on simple mode toggle + fix CI test
rawCommits.body:
SimpleShell was switching back to advanced when mounted on a non-chat
URL, making the Simple button appear broken. Now redirects to /chat
instead. CI workflow test sets localStorage to advanced mode before
navigating to project routes.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: redirect to /chat on simple mode toggle + fix CI test

rawCommits.subject: fix(test): set advanced mode in smoke test for project routes
rawCommits.cleanSubject: set advanced mode in smoke test for project routes

rendered.title: Public chat goes live with a Simple shell and full media support
rendered.intro: Today's nightly turns the logged-out experience into a real product surface: guests can stream chats without an account, generate images, video, and 3D models inline, and a new ChatGPT-style Simple shell gives signed-in users a lighter layout across web and desktop. The rest of the day went into hardening the public mode — mobile layout, error states, rate-limit accounting, and a server-side auth safety net.

entries.title: Public guest chat and the Simple shell launch
entries.summary: The logged-out surface becomes a first-class product: guests can stream chats without credentials, a new SimpleShell offers a ChatGPT-style layout, and public mode picks up 3D image attachments plus a global cost cap.

items.text: Guests can now stream public chats end-to-end over SSE: the interim login redirect is gone, and after a brief service-key approach the router was switched to an unauthenticated public-guest identity with IP-based rate limiting so no keys or env vars are needed.

New SimpleShell gives authenticated web users a sidebar-plus-chat layout, with a persisted simple/advanced preference in localStorage, an Advanced toggle in its titlebar and a matching Simple toggle in DesktopShell — and the hasDesktopBridge gates were removed so Desktop, web, and future mobile share the same shells.

Public mode picks up 3D generation from a source image: a file picker on the logged-out shell uploads an image, auto-fills a default prompt so send enables, and routes the request to Tripo without changing the shared input bar.
An atomic global daily ceiling (500 turns / 24h) now caps total public usage across all guests and IPs before per-guest or per-IP limits, protecting cost exposure for the open surface.
Minor polish on the public chat scroller adds bottom padding so messages clear the input bar.

entries.title: Desktop-quality assistant images in chat
entries.summary: Assistant-generated images now render with the same framing as desktop ImageBlock, giving public mode a polished media surface.

items.text: MessageBubble gained a dedicated assistant-image render path: generated images display at up to 520px with a rounded border frame and click-to-gallery with download, while 96px user attachment thumbnails are unchanged.

entries.title: Public chat hardening: inline media, mobile layout, and error UX
entries.summary: Through the morning the logged-out shell got the missing pieces to feel real — inline video and 3D playback, streaming indicators, mobile layout, and proper handling of expired tokens and rate-limit responses.

items.text: Video and 3D outputs now render inline in public mode using the same player and WebGLViewer as the rest of the app, after fixing a missing glbUrl field in both the backend payload normalizer and the frontend SSE extractor that had been hiding Tripo results.

Logged-out users now see the same ChatStreamingIndicator (cooking shimmer, progress text, stuck-stream pill) as the rest of the app, and stream failures surface as inline "stream interrupted" banners instead of failing silently.

Logged-out and Simple shells become mobile-friendly below 640px: single-column layout, a slide-in sidebar drawer with hamburger and backdrop, scrollable mode pills, and suppression of empty assistant bubbles on media-only messages.

Public chat now recovers from server-side auth and rate failures: invalid guest tokens are auto-invalidated so the next send mints a fresh one, and limit_reached responses open the KeepChattingModal instead of a generic error banner.
Marketing footer links were briefly switched to React Router and then reverted to external target=_blank URLs so they work in the Desktop shell as well as on the web.

entries.title: Rate limiter no longer leaks global budget on rejected retries
entries.summary: A reordering fix in the public rate limiter stops blocked requests from quietly consuming the global daily ceiling.

items.text: The public rate limiter now increments the global daily counter only after per-guest and per-IP checks pass, so a guest already at their cap can no longer drain the shared 500-turn budget on retry attempts.

entries.title: Auth token check restored for non-public sessions
entries.summary: A harness regression that weakened auth on authenticated sessions was closed.

items.text: The aura-os harness once again validates the auth token for all sessions and only skips the check when aura_org_id is public, restoring the safety net for authenticated traffic and unblocking the validate_rejects_missing_auth_token test.

entries.title: Simple mode deep links, dead code, and CI fixes
entries.summary: Late-day polish made the simple/advanced toggle behave correctly on deep links and got the e2e suites green again.

items.text: SimpleShell no longer hijacks non-chat URLs: project deep links, bookmarks, and CI routes now auto-switch to advanced mode so DesktopShell renders, while toggling Simple from a non-chat URL cleanly redirects to /chat instead of bouncing back.
E2E workflow and core-feature smoke tests now seed advanced mode in localStorage before visiting project routes, matching the new SimpleShell routing behavior.
Cleaned up the public chat hook by fixing stale closures (handleFileChange, dispatchChatTurn, dispatchMedia dep arrays) and removing the unused requiresLogin path and DisplayContentBlockUnion import.

highlights: Guest SSE chat with global daily cost ceiling
New SimpleShell with simple/advanced toggle on web and Desktop
Inline image, video, and 3D rendering in public chat
